versions.changelog:
- Updated handoff guidance: after writing this stage’s document, request a local mechanical check of existing documents; reserve the full check for when all five documents are ready.
- Removed `examples/minimal-image-prompt-specs.jsonl`, `scripts/image_prompt_check.py`, `scripts/selftest.py`, and `skill-card.md`.

short-drama-image-prompts v1.0.2

- Refined prompt entry format: each asset now uses "## IMG-... · 中文名" and clearer reference image listing with standardized REF-... syntax.
- Updated guideline to specify use of only actual (not planned) project reference images, detailing explicit reference usage, control, and limits.
- Improved instructions for disclosing asset references, including cases with no external references.
- Removed obsolete asset and specification files for improved maintainability.
- Clarified rules for prompt wording and strengthened documentation consistency.
Authorized ZenStory cold-start distribution; immutable source and preserved notices.
